words.note: 當 respect 強調對某人的品格、能力、成就或地位抱有高度評價時，可用 esteem。語氣較正式。
words.example: She is highly esteemed by her colleagues.

exercises.original: The professor is widely respected for her integrity and decades of careful research.
exercises.zh: 這位教授因誠信和數十年嚴謹研究而廣受敬重。
exercises.upgrade: esteemed · 尊重；敬重；高度評價

options.explanation: regarded = 被看待／被認為。通常需要補語，例如 highly regarded；單獨用 regarded 在這句不完整。
esteemed = 敬重。integrity + decades of careful research 表示因品格與成就而受到高度尊重。
admired = 欽佩。也接近，但 esteem 更正式，更突出專業上的高度評價。
valued = 重視。較強調重要性或價值，不完全等於敬重其品格。
looked up to = 仰慕。較口語，而且通常突出把某人當榜樣。
obeyed = 服從。尊重不等於服從命令。

exercises.original: The judge was respected throughout the legal profession for fairness and independence.
exercises.zh: 這名法官因公平和獨立，在法律界廣受敬重。
exercises.upgrade: esteemed · 尊重；敬重；高度評價

options.explanation: admired = 欽佩。可以形容個人特質，但法律專業語境中 esteemed 更正式。
valued = 重視。通常表示某人很重要，不一定是因品格受到敬重。
esteemed = 敬重。fairness and independence 正是令人高度尊重的專業品格。
regarded = 被看作。通常要說 highly regarded，單獨不完整。
followed = 跟隨。語義不合。
feared = 害怕。敬重和害怕不是同一意思。

exercises.original: She became one of the most respected surgeons in the country after years of outstanding work.
exercises.zh: 經過多年傑出工作，她成為全國最受敬重的外科醫生之一。
exercises.upgrade: esteemed · 尊重；敬重；高度評價

options.explanation: esteemed = 受敬重的。one of the most... + outstanding work 是典型正式高評價語境。
looked up to = 被仰慕。較口語，也更像榜樣關係。
valued = 被重視。不能自然表達專業聲望。
regarded = 被看待。需要 highly/well regarded，不能直接放入此結構。
admired = 受欽佩的。接近，但 esteemed 更適合專業地位與聲望。
trusted = 受信任的。信任只是尊重的一部分。

words.note: 當 respect 表示以尊重或高度評價看待某人／某事時，可用 regard。最常見的是 regard someone highly 或 be highly regarded。
words.example: She is highly regarded in the industry.

exercises.original: He is respected by colleagues as one of the most reliable engineers on the team.
exercises.zh: 同事都很尊重他，認為他是團隊中最可靠的工程師之一。
exercises.upgrade: highly regarded · 尊重；重視；看待

options.explanation: looked up to = 仰慕。較強調把他當榜樣。
admired = 欽佩。可以，但 as one of the most reliable... 更像專業評價。
valued = 重視。可表示他重要，但不等於專業聲譽很高。
highly regarded = 備受推崇。by colleagues + as one of... 是非常自然的搭配。
esteemed formally = 正式敬重。語意接近，但不是自然固定表達。
obeyed = 服從。和專業評價無關。

exercises.original: The charity is respected for using donations transparently and efficiently.
exercises.zh: 這間慈善機構因透明而有效地使用捐款而備受推崇。
exercises.upgrade: highly regarded · 尊重；重視；看待

options.explanation: admired personally = 個人欽佩。charity 是機構，而且重點是公共評價。
looked up to = 仰慕。通常用於人，不常直接用於機構。
highly regarded = 備受推崇。for transparency and efficiency 很自然。
feared = 害怕。語義錯。
followed = 跟隨。無關。
valued only = 只是重視。不能自然表達公共聲譽。

exercises.original: Her work is respected internationally because it has influenced policy in several countries.
exercises.zh: 她的工作在國際上備受推崇，因為影響了多個國家的政策。
exercises.upgrade: highly regarded · 尊重；重視；看待

options.explanation: valued = 被重視。可以，但不如 highly regarded 直接表達專業聲譽。
admired = 受欽佩。可以形容作品，但 international professional standing 更適合 regarded。
looked up to = 仰慕。通常主語是人。
feared = 被害怕。無關。
obeyed = 被服從。無關。
highly regarded = 備受推崇。internationally + influenced policy 是典型高評價語境。

words.note: 當 respect 強調因某人的才能、勇氣、品格、成就或做法而感到欽佩時，可用 admire。它比 respect 更帶正面欣賞色彩。
words.example: I admire her courage in speaking out.
words.exampleZh: 我很欽佩她敢於發聲的勇氣。

exercises.original: I respect her for staying calm and helping others during the emergency.
exercises.zh: 我很欽佩她在緊急情況下保持冷靜並幫助其他人。

options.explanation: regard = 看待／評價。通常要加 highly 或 with respect。
esteem = 敬重。較正式，也可以，但這裡是個人因勇氣和行為而產生欽佩。
admire = 欽佩。for staying calm and helping others 明確指出令人佩服的行為。
value = 重視。表示她很重要，不等於佩服她的行為。
obey = 服從。完全不同。
fear = 害怕。完全不同。

exercises.original: Many young athletes respect her because of the discipline and determination she showed throughout her career.
exercises.zh: 很多年輕運動員因她職業生涯中的自律和決心而欽佩她。

options.explanation: value = 重視。不是強調她的特質令人佩服。
look up to = 仰慕。也很接近，但本句直接指出 discipline and determination 這些可被欽佩的特質。
admire = 欽佩。因自律和決心而產生敬佩，非常自然。
regard formally = 正式看待。不是自然搭配。
obey = 服從。無關。
fear = 害怕。無關。

exercises.original: I have always respected people who admit their mistakes and try to correct them.
exercises.zh: 我一直很欽佩那些承認錯誤並努力改正的人。

options.explanation: admired = 欽佩。admit mistakes and correct them 是明確令人佩服的品格。
valued = 重視。表示重要性，不是對品格的欽佩。
obeyed = 服從。語義錯。
regarded = 看待。需要補語，如 regarded highly。
feared = 害怕。相反。
followed = 跟隨。不是尊重。

words.note: 當 respect 指對某人抱有敬仰，甚至把對方當成榜樣時，可用 look up to。這是常見口語片語。
words.example: Many students look up to their coach.
words.exampleZh: 很多學生都很敬仰他們的教練。

exercises.original: As a child, she respected her older sister and wanted to be like her.
exercises.zh: 她小時候很敬仰姐姐，也想成為像她一樣的人。
exercises.upgrade: looked up to · 敬仰；仰慕；把……當榜樣

options.explanation: admired only = 只是欽佩。也接近，但 wanted to be like her 更直接表明榜樣關係。
valued = 重視。不是模仿榜樣。
regarded = 看待。需要補語。
looked up to = 敬仰。wanted to be like her 是最典型線索。
obeyed = 服從。孩子可以服從姐姐，但不等於敬仰。
feared = 害怕。無關。

exercises.original: Many junior doctors respect the consultant because they see her as a model of professionalism.
exercises.zh: 很多初級醫生敬仰這名顧問醫生，視她為專業典範。
exercises.upgrade: looked up to · 敬仰；仰慕；把……當榜樣

options.explanation: esteemed = 敬重。較正式，可以，但 model of professionalism 更像榜樣意味。
valued = 重視。不是把她當榜樣。
looked up to = 敬仰。see her as a model 是直接線索。
regarded = 看待。需要補語。
followed orders from = 聽從命令。服從不等於敬仰。
feared = 害怕。無關。

exercises.original: He was respected by younger musicians who hoped to follow the same career path.
exercises.zh: 年輕音樂人都很敬仰他，希望走上相同的職業道路。
exercises.upgrade: looked up to · 敬仰；仰慕；把……當榜樣

options.explanation: looked up to = 敬仰。younger musicians + hoped to follow the same career path 明確顯示榜樣關係。
regarded neutrally = 中性看待。和尊敬相反。
obeyed = 服從。沒有命令關係。
feared = 害怕。無關。
valued financially = 從金錢上重視。完全不合。
ignored = 忽略。相反。

words.note: 當 respect 指重視某人的意見、時間、貢獻、權利或某種原則時，可用 value。它強調『認為重要、有價值』。
words.example: Good managers value their employees' ideas.
words.exampleZh: 好的管理者會重視員工的意見。

exercises.original: A good team leader respects everyone's contribution, even when opinions differ.
exercises.zh: 好的團隊領袖會重視每個人的貢獻，即使意見不同。

options.explanation: esteem = 敬重。通常是對人作高度評價，不是 contribution 的首選。
admire = 欽佩。這裡重點是重視每個人的投入。
regard = 看待／評價。需要補語。
look up to = 敬仰。通常用於人，不用於 contribution。
value = 重視。value someone's contribution 是非常自然的搭配。
obey = 服從。無關。

exercises.original: The company says it respects employees' time and tries to avoid unnecessary meetings.
exercises.zh: 公司表示重視員工的時間，並盡量避免不必要的會議。

options.explanation: admire = 欽佩。不能自然說 admire employees' time。
value = 重視。value someone's time 是固定自然搭配。
esteem = 敬重。通常針對人或地位，不直接接 time。
look up to = 敬仰。對象通常是人。
obey = 服從。無關。
fear = 害怕。無關。

exercises.original: The organisation respects honesty and openness in all of its partnerships.
exercises.zh: 這個機構在所有合作關係中都重視誠實和坦誠。

options.explanation: value = 重視。honesty and openness 是原則／價值，最自然用 value。
admire people = 欽佩人。對象不合。
look up to = 敬仰。不能接抽象原則。
regard as a person = 把……視為人。完全不合。
obey = 服從。不能服從 honesty。
fear = 害怕。無關。

words.note: 這是較正式的片語，表示對某人、某機構或某項工作抱有很高評價。它比一般 respect 更強。
words.example: She is held in high regard by her peers.

exercises.original: The scientist is deeply respected by researchers in several different fields.
exercises.zh: 這名科學家深受多個不同領域的研究人員推崇。
exercises.upgrade: held in high regard · 高度尊重；十分推崇

options.explanation: valued = 重視。可表示她有價值，但不完全等於高度專業聲望。
admired casually = 隨意欽佩。語氣太弱。
held in high regard = 高度推崇。deeply respected + researchers in several fields 是典型正式高評價語境。
looked up to by children = 被孩子敬仰。對象完全不合。
obeyed = 被服從。無關。
feared = 被害怕。無關。

exercises.original: The journal is respected internationally for its rigorous review process.
exercises.zh: 這本期刊因嚴謹的審稿程序而在國際上深受推崇。
exercises.upgrade: held in high regard · 高度尊重；十分推崇

options.explanation: admired personally = 個人欽佩。journal 不是人，而且重點是專業聲譽。
valued as cheap = 因便宜而被重視。和 rigorous review process 不符。
looked up to = 敬仰。通常不直接用於期刊。
held in high regard = 深受推崇。internationally + rigorous review process 明確表示專業高評價。
obeyed = 被服從。無關。
feared = 被害怕。無關。

exercises.original: Her advice is respected by senior executives because of her long experience in the industry.
exercises.zh: 她的建議因其長期業界經驗而深受高層管理人員重視和推崇。
exercises.upgrade: held in high regard · 高度尊重；十分推崇

options.explanation: held in high regard = 高度重視／推崇。long experience 是令其 advice 受到高評價的原因。
obeyed automatically = 自動服從。尊重建議不等於盲從。
feared = 害怕。無關。
ignored = 忽略。相反。
followed blindly = 盲從。不是尊重的同義詞。

options.text: looked up to as a person
options.explanation: looked up to as a person = 把她本人當榜樣。句子主語是 advice，不是她本人。

falseSynonyms.zh: 有禮貌的；表示尊重的不等於一般的 respect respectful 是形容詞，表示態度有禮或尊重；respect 是名詞或動詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Respect can be a noun or verb; respectful is an adjective.

falseSynonyms.zh: 值得尊敬的；體面的不等於一般的 respect respectable 表示某人／某事值得尊重或合乎體面，不等於實際去尊重某人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A respectable person may deserve respect.

falseSynonyms.zh: 服從不等於一般的 respect obedience 是服從命令或權威。尊重可以存在於沒有服從關係的情況中。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Respect does not necessarily mean obedience.

falseSynonyms.zh: 害怕不等於一般的 respect 害怕某人不等於尊重某人。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can fear someone without respecting them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 禮貌不等於一般的 respect politeness 是有禮的行為方式。禮貌可以表達尊重，但兩者不是同一概念。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Politeness can show respect, but it is not the same as respect.

falseSynonyms.zh: 贊成；認同不等於一般的 respect approval 表示贊成某個決定或做法；你可以尊重一個人但不同意他的意見。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can respect someone without approving of every decision.

falseSynonyms.zh: 聲譽不等於一般的 respect reputation 是別人對某人／機構的整體看法，不是 respect 本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A strong reputation may lead to respect.

falseSynonyms.zh: 權威；權力不等於一般的 respect authority 指合法權力或專業權威。有人可以有權威但未必受到真正尊重。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Authority can command compliance; respect must be earned or felt.
